title: 3D Items-Vanillaism
description: Install this resourcepack, and your items will no longer be 2D.
body:
## This resourcepack 3Dizes most items to make them look more immersive.


## Features:

Most items are changed to 3D models.

The items in the inventory is identical to the Vanilla.
